name: Voter ID address change (Form 8 - shifting of residence)
name_hi: मतदाता पहचान पत्र में पता परिवर्तन (फ़ॉर्म 8 – निवास स्थानांतरण)
description: An enrolled elector who has shifted residence applies in Form 8 to the Electoral Registration Officer of the constituency where the new address is. A replacement EPIC is issued on approval.
description_hi: निवास बदलने वाला पंजीकृत मतदाता फ़ॉर्म 8 में उस निर्वाचन क्षेत्र के निर्वाचक रजिस्ट्रीकरण अधिकारी को आवेदन करता है जहाँ नया पता स्थित है। स्वीकृति पर प्रतिस्थापन EPIC जारी किया जाता है।
verification_notes: Based on the ECI Form 8 and its guidelines. Form 8 also accepts other address-proof documents ('Any Other') that are not listed; only the listed documents are modelled. The Aadhaar number is optional; the applicant can declare that they don't have one.

requirements.name: Existing Voter ID (EPIC) number
requirements.description: Form 8 shifting is for an elector who is already registered/enrolled.
requirements.notes: If you are not enrolled yet, Form 8 is not the right form. Enrolment is outside the current knowledge base.

requirements.name: Proof of new address (any one)
requirements.description: Self-attested copy of any one listed document for the new address.
requirements.notes: May be in the name of the applicant or of a parent/spouse/adult child already enrolled at the same address. Other documents may be named under 'Any Other'.

options.notes: Connection bill for that address (at least 1 year).
Connection bill for that address (at least 1 year).
Connection bill for that address (at least 1 year).
Current passbook of a Nationalized/Scheduled Bank or Post Office.
Must be a registered rent lease deed (tenants).

requirements.name: Aadhaar number (for authentication of entries)
requirements.description: Requested for authentication, but an applicant without Aadhaar can declare that instead.
